commit.message:
docs: clarify encrypt_bet.mjs TEE public key is ephemeral

The hardcoded TEE_PUBKEY_X/Y comment implied the key was still current;
it isn't after subsequent container restarts. Note that these values
must be refreshed from /info before reuse.

feat: implement processWithdraw TEE signing logic

- Add packWithdrawalMessage (abi.encodePacked amount+to+withdrawalId, 84 bytes)
- Add signWithTEE (POST to /sign endpoint, mirrors decryptViaTee pattern)
- Rewrite processWithdraw to produce WithdrawResponse with TEE signature
- Add WithdrawResponse type to pkg/types/types.go
- Add unit tests: TestProcessAction_ValidWithdraw, TestProcessWithdraw_SignFails
- Add encrypt_bet.mjs: go-ethereum ecies compatible ECIES encryption for placeBet
- Verified end-to-end: withdraw() -> TEE sign -> executeWithdrawal() on Coston2

refactor: rename scaffold actions to prediction market types

- Replace GREETING/SAY_HELLO/SAY_GOODBYE with PREDICTION_MARKET/DEPOSIT/PLACE_BET/SETTLE/WITHDRAW

upgrade tee-node/tee-proxy to support Coston2 redeploy

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
